configuration.title: F4Data Dashboards
setting.localCopy.description: Create local snapshots of a dashboard's data before opening it.
setting.localCopy.off: Use data from its configured location without creating a local copy.
setting.localCopy.auto: Copy data only when it is on a detected network filesystem and meets the size threshold.
setting.localCopy.always: Create a local copy whenever the dashboard uses the conventional data/ folder.
setting.localCopyThresholdMb.description: Minimum data/ size in megabytes before auto mode copies a detected network source.
setting.localCopyKeep.description: Keep local copies for this VS Code session, or for N days after last use (for example, days:7).
setting.reuseDuckDbInstance.description: Reuse one DuckDB instance while a dashboard is open. Can keep source database files locked until released or idle timeout.
setting.duckdbIdleReleaseSeconds.descrip: Close an idle reused DuckDB instance after this many seconds. Set to 0 to disable the idle timeout.
setting.duckdbMaxConcurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous DuckDB connections for a reused dashboard instance.
setting.previewRows.description: Maximum number of rows sampled for each initial dataset preview. Set to 0 to return schema only.
setting.maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows returned by a dashboard query. Set to 0 (default) to return all rows; positive values limit the result up to 100000.
setting.pauseWhenHidden.description: Cancel active queries and defer automatic data refreshes while the dashboard Webview is hidden.
